item.title: GreyScale-紫波 #greyscale #紫波 #prophet5 #duos #polysequencer
item.description: video upload by plantssystem "‪@plantssystem-ufo‬ GreyScale New Single '紫波' A deep purple scene melting into silence. This new release, '紫波,' features the rich overtones of the legendary analog synthesizer Prophet-5 and the chaotic textures of the Duos. Enjoy a rich sonic experience where the warmth of analog meets the unpredictable noise."
